greeting: Feet hurting? I can fix that!
Sole Sister Sue, at your service! Best boots in the Dustbelt!
New shoes, new adventures! What do you need?
Your boots look TIRED, friend! Let me help!
Walked far? Of course you have! Heroes walk! I make walking better!
Sand in your shoes? I have solutions!
Every journey starts with good footwear! That's science!
dialog.shop_open: Explorer boots! Dune walkers! Scorpion-stompers! I've got it all!
dialog.shop_prompt: Custom fitted! Desert tested! Adventure approved!
haggle: Quality costs, but I'll meet you halfway!
For a fellow walker? Special price!
These soles are REINFORCED! Worth every coin!
Throw in old boots for trade-in! Fair deal!
purchase_success: Perfect fit! You'll walk on clouds! Dust clouds, but still!
Those'll last a thousand miles! Guaranteed!
purchase_fail: Good boots are an investment! Think about it!
Your feet deserve better! Come back when ready!
Can't walk on dreams alone! Though I've tried!
rumor: Deep-Dig Dan needs better boots. Goes through a pair a month!
Barrelman Bob wears the same size as that luchador. Weird, right?
Heard the twins in Uplands walk BAREFOOT! On purpose! Madness!
My sister Blue makes sandals. Sandals! In the desert! I love her anyway.
dialog.quest_hook: Need special leather for a rush order! Sand-wyrm hide, from the Scorched Wastes! Dangerous, but the PAY is good! Bring me hide, I'll make you the best boots you've ever worn!
dialog.quest_active: Any wyrm hide yet? Customer's desperate! I'm desperate!
dialog.quest_complete: PERFECT hide! Look at this quality! Here - your boots! Custom made! Lifetime warranty!
farewell: Walk safe! Walk far! Walk in comfort!
Come back when those need re-soling!
dialog.time_dawn: Early start? Smart! Beat the heat AND get good shoes!
dialog.time_noon: Hot pavement! Good boots protect! Want to see?
dialog.time_dusk: Evening stroll? I have JUST the slippers!
dialog.time_night: Night walking? Dangerous! Get boots with grip!
dialog.post_quest_greeting: The wyrm-hunter returns! How are the new boots fitting?
dialog.sister_mention: Blue's in Uplands. Making sandals. I love her, but SANDALS!

party_reactions.kade: Finally, someone who understands the importance of good boots.
party_reactions.nix7: Efficient footwear essential for optimal travel. Logical.
party_reactions.twist: Do you have boots my size? Extra wide?
party_reactions.renna: Can you make boots that don't look like adventure boots?

relationship_dialog.stranger: First time? Let's measure! Free fitting!
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: Back already? Wearing out the merchandise! Good!
relationship_dialog.friend: For you, I keep the premium stock! Hidden in back!
relationship_dialog.best_friend: You're family now! Custom designs! Anything you want!

mini_quest.title: Hide and Seek
mini_quest.description: Hunt sand-wyrms in Scorched Wastes for special leather

stages.hook: Need sand-wyrm hide for a rush order! Dangerous, but the PAY is good! And I'll make YOU boots too!
stages.active: Scorched Wastes! Big wyrms! Bring hide! Don't get eaten!
stages.complete: This hide is PERFECT! Look at the texture! Here - your custom wyrm-skin boots! Light as feather, tough as dragon!
